resources.string: Translates the text on your screen when you tap the floating AnyTranslate button, the Quick Settings tile or the accessibility shortcut. AnyTranslate reads the visible text (and, if enabled, a screenshot for text inside images) only at that moment, translates it on your device and draws the translation on top. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
